_what: NOISECOR applied by make_cutouts.py: cutout_noise = i2d ERR x factor. Measured by measure_corr_factor.py (diagnostics/corr_factor/), 2026-10-04; see AGENTS.md *Correlated noise*.
_how: Blank-sky block-sum ratio at scale_arcsec (the noise of an s x s patch over what ERR predicts), median over the SPT stamps per channel, thr3 source mask. Not the HST repo's drop-window ACF factor: the residual 1/f after clean_flicker_noise is correlated over ~3 arcsec along detector rows and a 1-px window never sees it. The ratio keeps growing with scale (block_ratio_curve), so a model must rescale if its source pixels footprint the image plane at a coarser scale than scale_arcsec.

block_ratio_curve.per_pixel_c0: 0.45-0.55 in every SPT band: drizzle (pixfrac 1, 0.031->0.03 and 0.063->0.06) halves the per-pixel variance, as it should

_overrides_why: B1938+666 (88 ks) is too deep for the blank-sky method, so its factors come from split_noise_test.py (2026-10-04): the 21 dithers split into two half-mosaics, A-B cancels every astrophysical feature, block-sum ratio of A-B against sqrt(ERR_A^2+ERR_B^2) inside the 12" stamp region at 0.2". F115W 0.94, F277W 1.12. Per pixel the F277W ERR is low by ~1.5 (ratio 1.04 where drizzle alone gives 0.7; also seen on single cal frames) but that cancels against the drizzle correlation by 0.2". The SW value is well below the SPT channel 1.30 because the 1/f is relatively weaker in MEDIUM8 8-group x 5-integration ramps than in TEMPLATES' 2-3 group BRIGHT2/SHALLOW2 exposures (Rigby+25 s7.2), and the per-frame ERR has no deficit (1.07).

correlation.kind: residual 1/f after clean_flicker_noise, coherent along detector rows (fast-read axis)
correlation.row_direction_note: SPT module-B frames; B1938 frames have their own roll. Use the stamp's detector PA if it matters.
correlation.not_in_factor: The factor is a scalar at scale_arcsec; it does not encode the anisotropy or the scale dependence. PyAutoLens's inversion ignores noise_covariance_matrix (autoarray 2026.9.27), so there is no consumer for the full structure yet.

split_test._note: diagnostics/split_noise/<lens>_<FILT>.json has the full output; half-mosaics in data/mosaics_splitA|B/.
